description: Greater Manchester lane-guidance checkpoints. Expected values are the owner's recorded reports (app repo CLAUDE.md), to be checked against our lane data; they are not ground truth. Coordinates were located only from OSM-derived sources: the published lane squares' own way names/refs/geometry, Nominatim (search/lookup/reverse, 1 request per second, descriptive User-Agent) and small read-only bounding-box reads of the OpenStreetMap API (api.openstreetmap.org/api/0.6/map.json) for nodes and untagged-lane slip roads absent from the lane files. No proprietary source was used or stored.
heading_convention: compass degrees of travel, taken from the local bearing of the OSM way the checkpoint lies on

Lane square lanes-106_-5.json: eastbound one-way Brinksway ways 954199037 -> 2246322 -> 1291544924 (lanes=2), splitting at 53.40691,-2.17397

OSM API map bbox -2.1770,53.4055,-2.1720,53.4085: traffic_signals nodes 1428486877 (on straight-on way 954199038) and 9735283875 (on primary_link 954026108 to Hollywood Way northbound) just after that split
Point placed 20 m before the end of way 2246322 along its geometry (bearing 44)
checkpoints.uncertainty: The report does not say which arm; the eastbound 2-lane approach to the signals nearest the M60 J1 side was chosen. OSM topology there splits into a left primary_link (towards Hollywood Way / Pyramid Roundabout) and straight-on Brinksway, which reads like [left | straight] rather than [straight | right]; a human should confirm the arm.
